title: Library artefact coordinates, the policy cache time to live, the authorise payload and the split of the masking read between P4's policy and P1's read are not specified
source: Legacy RWB-E1-037 sections 4, 12 and 13 (published package recovery.access.matrix with the ScopeFilter, FieldMasker and isUnmasked signatures); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 10, 14, 20 and 35; Ownership Map v1 (no api row for POST /authorise, GET /me/permissions or /masking-policies)
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 13 Solution plan
description: (a) No source names the library artefact coordinates: the package coordinate, the repository and the publication channel that the service template pins are absent, and slide 20 says only that every service comes from the service template and the shared libraries. (b) No source fixes the cache time to live of the cached permission and masking policy, or the parameter key that holds it; slide 20 requires a cache refresh on the two access events and names no interval. (c) No source fixes the request and answer payload of POST /authorise beyond the words role, scope and DoA on slide 14, nor the answer of /masking-policies. (d) No source fixes how the masking read is divided between the masking policy that P4 rwb-access owns and the masked values that P1 rwb-source-data exposes, so the point where the policy stops and the data read starts is open.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-037 section 12 publishes three signatures and no payload; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 10 (each service authorises the object itself using cached permission data from rwb-access, 2 s timeouts, breaker per downstream); slide 14 (POST /authorise (role, scope, DoA), GET /me/permissions, GET /doa-limits, /masking-policies); slide 20 (AccessPolicyChanged and DoaLimitChanged to cache refresh); Ownership Map v1 has no api row for the three access operations and no table row for a library cache.
owner_role: Platform library architect with the P4 rwb-access owner and the P1 rwb-source-data owner
proposed: Publish the artefact at a platform coordinate with major version 1, hold the cache time to live in a parameter read through the parameters client, publish the authorise and masking-policy payloads from the words slide 14 uses, and state that the policy decides clear or masked while the data owner supplies the masked or last-four value; record the three shapes at the contract freeze.

title: The contract shapes of the guard and masker, the /masking-policies path, the audit record shape and the failure mapping are not specified
source: Legacy RWB-E1-037 sections 4, 5, 12 and 13 (the three published signatures and the X1 to X10 exception table); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 10, 11, 14 and 20; Ownership Map v1 (no api row for /masking-policies and no row for the access-log write)
section: 3 Preconditions; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan
description: (a) No source fixes the contract shape of the three interfaces: the input and output types of the guard, the scope guard and the mask applier, and the attribute set of the personal-data annotation, are absent from every technical specification. (b) No source gives the method, the base or the answer of the masking-policy operation: slide 14 writes /masking-policies with no verb and no base, and the Ownership Map has no path row for it, so the base rule of Template and Rules section R4 has to be applied. (c) No source fixes the audit record shape beyond the requirement that it carries the case id, the field id and the masked flag and never the value. (d) No source maps a timeout, an unreachable access owner or a malformed answer to a status and a message, so the fail-closed rule of slide 10 has to be expressed as the 503 with no business data.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-037 section 12 (three signatures with no payload), section 5 X1 to X10 (statuses and messages of the monolith), section 8 BR11 (the access log record); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 10 (2 s timeout, breaker per downstream, deny by default); slide 11 (RFC 9457 problem details, one hop); slide 14 (/masking-policies named without a verb); slide 20 (the two access events); Ownership Map v1 api rows carry no entry for /masking-policies and no row for the access-log write.
owner_role: Platform library contract owner with the P4 rwb-access contract owner
proposed: Publish the three interfaces with their types and the annotation with its field-id attribute, reach the masking policy at GET /api/recovery/access/v1/masking-policies, fix the audit record as case id, field id and the flag clear or masked, and map every access-owner failure to 503 with no business data; record the four shapes at the contract freeze.
